evidence.t: Road: Kookipi Creek FSR, 5.0 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
27 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-15 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 125 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.0, -121.6367, pull off on Kookipi Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Kookipi Creek FSR stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 99 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-15, Region 3. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
